preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output must be a list.

postconditions.expression: all(char in string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.whitespace for char in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be a letter, number, or whitespace character.
The output list must contain only unique characters.

postconditions.expression: all(char in output for char in input if input.count(char) > 1)
postconditions.description: The output list must contain only characters that are repeated in the input string.

postconditions.expression: output == sorted(output, key=lambda c: input.index(c, input.index(c)+1))
postconditions.description: The output list must be sorted by the order of the first repetition of each character in the input string.
